ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark gray) with a very low ratio of high-intensity pixels (approx. 1:50). High-intensity pixels are limited to small, discrete points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous solid dark-pigmented region covering >98% of the visible surface. High-contrast white pixels appear as isolated, non-contiguous point-clusters scattered across the mid-region of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped indentation with an internal angle of approximately 105 degrees. The vertex is well-defined at the central convergence of the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the full extent of the trailing edge. Pixel-amplitude of peaks varies between 5-15 pixels relative to local mean edge line. Significant jaggedness observed on distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to a convex curve towards the distal tips. Leading edge (lower boundary in image) shows a generally linear trajectory with slight convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several discrete, roughly circular white pixel clusters (approx 2-8 pixels in diameter) detected on the left lobe's medial surface and near the central fluke region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, circular white depigmented spots scattered across the dark surface. Distinctive irregular notches and jagged variations along the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Uniformity of dark pigmentation across nearly the entire ventral surface, providing high contrast against the surrounding water and surface spray.
